post_text:
Janu Al Marjan Island will stack 73 private homes in a 29-storey tower, crowned by a 1,761 m² penthouse.

On 29 October, La Revue des Hôtels detailed the residential side of the Janu project in Ras Al Khaimah, about 70 km from Dubai. The homes range from one to five bedrooms and from 197 to 1,096 m². They have been on sale off-plan since October, with prices on request only.

The tower stands beside a 132-room Janu hotel designed by SCDA Architects, with a 265-metre private beach, a 2,496 m² spa and six restaurants and bars. Owners get their own entrance and a 24-hour private office with priority at Janu and Aman hotels.

The site belongs to @Marjan, whose Group CEO @Abdulla Al Abdouli broke ground in July alongside Wynn Resorts. @Vlad Doronin, Chairman and CEO of @Aman, called the island "a natural home for the brand". Marjan points to a 2029 opening.

The signal: Janu, the sister brand Aman created in 2020, is adopting the Aman playbook. Sell the homes first, years before the first guest arrives, and let residences help finance the hotel.

Would you buy a branded home off-plan, years before the hotel opens?
